prompt:
Use case: historical-scene. Create ONE premium vertical 4:5 high-detail miniature city panorama poster for an Assassin's Creed main-game city collection. Pure warm white backdrop, top 18 percent is an elegant editorial masthead with oversized black condensed uppercase city title, small game subtitle and period line, a delicate city-specific skyline silhouette. Lower area is a dense beautifully crafted realistic 3D historical city miniature, elevated oblique aerial perspective, continuous coherent urban fabric, on a complete thick dark rectangular display plinth with all front corners visible and white margins. Museum-quality architectural materials and tiny period inhabitants, convincing scale, crisp natural light with subtle atmospheric depth, restrained vivid colors, rich authentic details, clear landmark hierarchy. Compressed artistic geography, not an exact map. No collage panels, modern buildings, modern vehicles, football elements, sports crests, wooden plaques, watermarks, or extra words. This is an original historical city visualization inspired by the game setting, not a screenshot.
City title exactly "BAGHDAD". Subtitle exactly "ASSASSIN'S CREED MIRAGE". Period exactly "ABBASID CALIPHATE · 861". Subject: Abbasid Baghdad with monumental Round City as recognizable main structure: concentric circular mudbrick defensive walls and radial streets, central Palace of the Golden Gate with a green dome, adjacent Great Mosque, dense outer quarters with rooftop terraces and courtyards, libraries and scholars' courtyards suggesting House of Wisdom, Tigris flowing along side with simple riverboats and wooden docks, date palms, textile markets. Honey-colored brick, emerald dome, turquoise river, subtle red awnings. No modern skyline, Ottoman mosques, Samarra spiral minaret or oversized modern golden dome.
